data.one_liner: Easily create toast messages with or without BuildContext in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a toast library for Flutter that supports displaying messages on Android, iOS, and Web. Offers two modes: a simple one with no BuildContext (limited features) and one requiring BuildContext with full UI control, queueing, and removal capabilities.
use_when: You need to quickly display temporary feedback messages or notifications to users.
You want support for both simple native/web-based toasts and fully custom widget-based toasts.
avoid_when: You need persistent snackbars with actions (use ScaffoldMessenger instead).
You require complex overlay notification management systems (consider alternatives like bot_toast).
strengths: Supports both context-free native toasts and fully custom widget toasts.
Queues custom toasts and allows clearing or canceling them programmatically.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, and Web.
weaknesses: Custom toast styling on Android is limited on API 30+ (Android 11 and above).
Context-free toasts have limited styling and UI control.
data.setup_notes: For custom widget toasts, you can optionally update your MaterialApp with the FToastBuilder and a navigatorKey for global context access.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you need advanced toast, loading, and notification overlays with robust queue management.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you want modern, customizable notification toasts with rich animations.

alternatives.name: another_flushbar
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you want feature-rich flushbars/snackbars with buttons, progress indicators, and custom layouts.

data.minimal_example:
Fluttertoast.showToast(
    msg: "This is Center Short Toast",
    toastLength: Toast.LENGTH_SHORT,
    gravity: ToastGravity.CENTER,
    timeInSecForIosWeb: 1,
    backgroundColor: Colors.red,
    textColor: Colors.white,
    fontSize: 16.0
);
